Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
We are looking for a Backend Data Engineer with 3+ years of experience to join a fast-paced organization working with modern data platforms, AI-assisted development tools, and rapidly evolving technologies. The ideal candidate combines strong engineering skills with ownership, collaboration, and a product-oriented mindset.
 Responsibilities
Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, models, and backend data infrastructure
Develop and optimize transformation workflows using dbt and cloud data platforms such as Snowflake and/or Databricks
Build and manage workflow orchestration for reliable, production-grade data processes
Create internal data applications and tooling using technologies such as Streamlit
Work closely with Data Product Managers to translate business and product requirements into practical technical solutions
Collaborate across engineering, analytics, and product teams; ask the right questions, challenge assumptions when needed, and help shape solutions
Use modern GenAI development tools such as Cursor, Snowflake CoWork, Codex, Claude Code, and similar tools to accelerate engineering workflows
Take ownership from design through implementation, deployment, and continuous improvement
 Requirements
4+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Backend Engineering, or a related role
Strong hands-on experience with dbt, SQL, data modeling, and data pipelines
Experience with Snowflake and/or Databricks and modern orchestration tools
Strong communication, teamwork, ownership, reliability, and professional work ethic
Ability to operate independently in a dynamic environment where requirements may evolve quickly
Comfort adopting new technologies and using GenAI tools as part of the day-to-day engineering workflow
 Would be a plus
Hands-on experience with Python, REST APIs, or backend service development
Experience with Streamlit or similar frameworks for data-driven applications
 What we offer
Comfortable environment, challenging tasks and a long-term interesting project;
Covered 20 days of vacation;
Public holidays;
Mobilization reservation available upon successful completion of the probation period (for Ukrainian colleagues);
Bookkeeping by a professional accountant;
Help and support from our caring HR-team
